title: Sarj Wiki MCP and REST guide

authentication.method: Google-backed native OAuth; no permanent API key or copied Google credential is required.
authentication.consent: Read access is the default. Document changes need the separate, unchecked-by-default approval.
authentication.revocation: Disconnect the client from Wiki App connections to revoke both MCP and REST access.

claude_code.direct_configuration_command: claude mcp add --transport http sarj-wiki https://api-wiki.sarj.ai/mcp
claude_code.sign_in: Authenticate in the MCP menu and review the Wiki consent screen.
claude_code.plugin_contents: Remote MCP configuration only; no local server, shell hook, or executable.

claude_web_and_desktop.reason: Wiki supports Dynamic Client Registration. Client ID Metadata Documents are intentionally disabled.
claude_web_and_desktop.cli_callback: Allowed loopback address with an ephemeral port and /callback path.

codex.existing_configuration: Inspect an existing entry before replacing it.

defaults.idempotency_key: Server-generated UUID, returned in the response

polish_by_document_id.source_access: Google authorizes the explicitly supplied ID. Native Google Docs shared outside the navigable workspace are supported, including sources that do not expose their parent folder.

optional_fields.copy_destination_folder_id: Writable folder in the signed-in user Wiki workspace

polish_by_document_id.in_place: Must be explicitly requested and satisfy existing native-document eligibility checks. An editor grant alone does not make an unowned personal-Drive Doc eligible. Copy options are invalid for in-place edits.
polish_by_document_id.permission_boundaries: This shortcut does not broaden search, navigation, copy-destination access, or other file mutations.
retry_contract: Generate a UUID before the first call when timeout recovery is needed.
Reuse that key only for the same source ID, mode, output name, destination, and output strategy.
The first admitted source version stays bound to the operation. A later source edit does not create another task when the original key is retried.
A lost response cannot reveal a server-generated key; a client needing ambiguous-response recovery should supply its own key.
polish_by_document_id.completion: Pending or running is not completion. Check terminal status, validation, findings, and needs_review before presenting an output as ready. A successful task is not a substitute for visual review.
polish_by_document_id.advanced_tool: wiki_polish_document remains available for callers who already have a reviewed expected_modified_time and an explicit idempotency key.

oauth_rest.authentication: Use the same MCP OAuth resource and scopes. Google access tokens, browser-session JWTs, and cookies do not authorize this API.
oauth_rest.submission_response: Same response shape as the MCP ID shortcut. Follow the relative Location on the same API origin.

error_contract.details: Provider errors are redacted; input is bounded.

oauth_rest.read_security: Task ownership and fresh completed-output access are checked. All responses are private and non-cacheable.

first_party_session_route.authentication: Existing Wiki session security boundary; third-party clients should use the OAuth API.

distribution.anthropic_directory: Separate submission and approval process. A repository manifest does not imply Anthropic approval.
